name: Triangle Hunter
source:
A simple adventure game where Kyouya from Triangle Heart 3 searches for heroines on the map and attacks them with radio waves.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
《三角之心3》的恭也在地图上寻找女主角，并用无线电波攻击她们，这是一款简单的冒险游戏。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
